name: ClickUp Whiteboards
description: ClickUp Whiteboards is ClickUp's collaborative visual canvas for brainstorming, diagrams, planning, templates, and turning ideas into connected tasks. Whiteboards can contain shapes, sticky notes, drawings, text, images, links, and ClickUp work items and can be shared publicly or privately according to plan and role permissions.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate ClickUp Whiteboards connection or install. Use the canonical ClickUp provider only for its approved bounded Workspace and task workflows. Relay does not read or edit canvas objects, create Whiteboards or templates, convert objects to tasks, export boards, or change sharing because ClickUp does not publish a typed external Whiteboards API under its current public API contract.

blocked.label: Create a Whiteboards connection
blocked.description: Whiteboards use the same ClickUp account, Workspace, role, permissions, and product lifecycle as canonical ClickUp without publishing separate provider authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Whiteboard tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported ClickUp operations through one canonical provider rather than parallel credentials, policies, actions, and audit state.

blocked.label: Read or edit a canvas
blocked.description: Reading, searching, creating, moving, formatting, connecting, grouping, locking, deleting, importing, or exporting canvas objects is not available through a typed ClickUp public API.

blocked.label: Convert ideas into work
blocked.description: Creating or changing tasks from canvas objects, embedding tasks or Docs, and synchronizing object and work-item state are blocked; ordinary task actions remain canonical ClickUp operations.

blocked.label: Share or administer Whiteboards
blocked.description: Public and private links, invitations, roles, view placement, templates, plan limits, export permissions, search indexing, embeds, and Workspace security administration remain signed-in product state.

blocked.label: Use private ClickUp interfaces
blocked.description: Sessions, cookies, passwords, verification codes, browser automation, scraping, undocumented endpoints, beta MCP, arbitrary links, and raw requests are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use ClickUp
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Whiteboards action is enabled because the canvas is a ClickUp Workspace product without a supported external API contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No ClickUp Whiteboards tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses canonical ClickUp only for approved bounded Workspace and task workflows.
No ClickUp Whiteboards tools are mounted. Hermes uses canonical ClickUp only for approved bounded Workspace and task workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: ClickUp Whiteboards is a collaborative canvas and view inside a ClickUp Workspace, not a separate provider identity or authorization surface. ClickUp documents canvas creation and editing, templates, work-item embeds, public and private links, plan limits, and role-based access as product workflows. Its public API reference does not publish typed Whiteboard, canvas-object, template, export, sharing, or collaboration endpoints. Relay's canonical ClickUp V1 already owns OAuth and Workspace selection and intentionally exposes only eight bounded task tools. A duplicate card would misstate authority, while browser automation or private endpoints would violate the external API boundary.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and use canonical ClickUp only for its current explicit task operations. Revisit only if ClickUp publishes stable external Whiteboard APIs with typed canvas resources, granular authorization, bounded traversal and payload rules, task and Doc embed semantics, sharing and permission controls, idempotent writes, export fidelity, template and deletion lifecycle, audit, redaction, rate and plan limits, and terms suitable for Relay.

evidence.supports: ClickUp describes Whiteboards as a platform canvas with real-time collaboration, shapes, sticky notes, drawing, flowcharts, object formatting, and conversion of visual objects into tasks.
ClickUp documents plan-based public and private Whiteboard limits and role-based view, edit, creation, and template authority.
ClickUp documents public and private external sharing, Workspace access, view-only and edit links, and incomplete evolving permission functionality as product UI state.
ClickUp documents public Whiteboard and Whiteboard-view links, embeds, plan-specific location rules, search indexing, and Enterprise administration.
ClickUp identifies its documented v2 and v3 reference as the public API surface and requires OAuth for third-party applications; that surface does not publish Whiteboard resources or actions.
